flags: The strip map runs Juliette to Gray, opposite GDOT’s descriptive itinerary; intro and moments use the strip-map direction. GDOT identifies East Juliette as the endpoint while also describing the end as the river in Juliette.
GDOT supplies forest character and road sequence but no grades, curves or driving time; those details are omitted. Its map says 21 miles, while the catalog maps 22.8; no total mileage is asserted.
The trail and Round Oak naming accounts do not identify a particular nation. No tribal source is cached, so the draft does not assign one.
Round Oak is shorter than 90 words because the relevant evidence is limited; the cache does not establish survival of the namesake oak or depot.
